SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 2, Special Branch. Shanghai.
REPORT
Date. May 15, 1936

MUNICIPAL POLICE
File No. REGISTR
D. D.

Subject Miss T. I. Hvaschenko-Kostetskaya.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by

With reference to the attached memo of the Personal Assistant
to D.C. (Crime), dated May 4, 1936, on the subject of Miss
Tania Kostetskaya, enquiries show that the correct and full
name of this individual is Miss Tatiana Ivanovna Hvaschenko-
Kostetskaya. She is a Russian who was born on June 18, 1902,
at Yingkow, South Manchuria. Her father died when she was
still a child and she resided in Harbin with her mother who
worked as a dressmaker. She attended the Harbin Normal
School for some time, after which she was employed as a waitress
in the "Solomon Restaurant" and subsequently in the "Peking
Hotel Restaurant" in that city.

It is reported that when in Harbin she cohabited for some
time with a certain Russian name unknown, who was employed with
a pharmacy, and by whom she had a son in 1922. At present the
boy is with her in Shanghai and attends the "Ecole Remi",
French Concession.

Miss Hvaschenko-Kostetskaya arrived in Shanghai from Harbin
in 1930, but registered with the local Bureau of Public Safety
only on February 20, 1936 on the strength of visa No. 1598
issued on 30.9.1930 at Kirin, Manchuria. Following her arrival
in Shanghai she has been working as a dancing partner in various
local cabarets, her present place of employment being the
"Palais Cafe", No. 57/9 Avenue Edward VII. It is reported that
in 1933/1934 she cohabited with one R. Marsh, American, a
cabaret manager and bar-tender by occupation, who was formerly
employed with the "Crystal" Cabaret, No. 11 Rue Chu Pao San.
It appears that she left him after she had discovered that he
was unfaithful to her.

While in Shanghai she is known to have resided for various

报告
日期：1936年5月15日

市警察局
档案号 REGISTR
D. D.

事由：T. I. Hvaschenko-Kostetskaya 小姐。

撰写人：D.S. Tcheremshansky。转呈人

关于刑事处副处长私人助理于1936年5月4日就 Tania Kostetskaya 小姐一事所附备忘录，经查询，此人的正确全名为 Tatiana Ivanovna Hvaschenko-Kostetskaya 小姐。她是俄罗斯人，1902年6月18日出生于南满营口。父亲在她幼年时去世，她与从事裁缝工作的母亲居住在哈尔滨。她曾就读于哈尔滨师范学校一段时间，之后在该市的“所罗门餐厅”（Solomon Restaurant）担任女服务员，随后又在“北京饭店餐厅”（Peking Hotel Restaurant）工作。

据报，她在哈尔滨期间曾与一名姓名不详的俄罗斯男子同居一段时间，该男子受雇于一家药房，她于1922年为其生下一子。目前该男孩随其在上海，就读于法租界的“雷米学校”（Ecole Remi）。

Hvaschenko-Kostetskaya 小姐于1930年从哈尔滨抵达上海，但直到1936年2月20日才凭1930年9月30日在满洲吉林签发的第1598号签证向当地公安局登记。抵沪后，她一直在当地各家歌舞厅担任舞伴，目前的受雇地点为爱德华七世路57/9号的“宫殿咖啡馆”（Palais Cafe）。据报，1933/1934年间，她曾与一名美国人 R. Marsh 同居，该人职业为歌舞厅经理及酒吧侍者，此前受雇于朱葆三路11号的“水晶”（Crystal）歌舞厅。看来她在发现他对她不忠后便离开了他。

在上海期间，已知她曾先后居住于以下地址：

瓦隆路（Route Vallon）106弄3号。自1932年2月30日至1932年4月1日。
霞飞路（Avenue Joffre）925弄1号。数月，直至1934年8月27日。
林达台（Linda Terrace）11号。自1934年11月至1935年9月。
自1935年9月起，她与母亲 A. Kostetskaya 夫人及妹妹 M. I. Peteretz 夫人（V.I. Peteretz 之妻）居住在福煦路620号。V.I. Peteretz 受雇于当地俄文报纸《NOVOSTI DNIA》（《日报》），担任业务及印刷部经理。
市警察局档案中没有任何对 Hvaschenko-Kostetskaya 小姐不利的记录。

                                        G. Tcheremshansky.
